notes.title: About mail order of physical version
notes.notes:
Physical version is sold at the shop in Japan. But this mail order site can only be purchased in Japan.
https://beep.theshop.jp/items/9508743
https://beep.theshop.jp/items/9508768


If you want it, you can trade by sending an e-mail directly to the shop.
(The delivery method is EMS, payment is paypal)

You can order the physical version of the game and soundtrack.

This is the shop's e-mail adress.
master@beep-shop.com

Thanks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31644066/52a0981c1277837872efd53d23580712e7d0c7d0.jpg[/img]
